    Title

    Therapy Aide - Physical Therapy
      Under the direction of the Director and/or Assistant Director of the Physical Therapy Department, the Therapy Aide provides essential support to the therapy team by escorting patients, transferring them on and off equipment, and performing patient programs under supervision of a licensed physical therapist. The Therapy Aide also assists with maintaining the general upkeep of the department.
